# Descriptions
@@ 1
Target is stunned.
@@ 2
Target hesitates in any nondefensive action. He suffers a -20 to initiative
rolls and he must parry with at least half of his OB.
@@ 3
Target takes 25% of his remaining concussion hits (i.e., those not already
taken).
@@ 4
Target takes an 'A' Electricity critical strike.
@@ 5
As Jolts I, except for duration.
@@ 7
Target is paralyzed.
@@ 8
As Shock A, except Electricity critical is a 'B'.
@@ 9
As Minor Pain, except 50% of remaining concussion hits are taken.
@@ 10
Everyone except the caster within the area of effect is a target, all failing
to resist are stunned.
@@ 11
As Jolts I, except for duration.
@@ 12
As Paralyze I, except duration is 3 rounds per 10 failure.
@@ 13
As Shock A, except Electricity critical is a 'C'.
@@ 15
As Mind Shout I, except area of effect is 50' radius.
@@ 16
As Shock A, except Electricity critical is a 'D'.
@@ 17
As Paralyze I, except duration is 5 rounds per 10 failure.
@@ 18
As Jolts I, except for duration.
@@ 19
As Mind Shout I, except area of efect is 100' radius.
@@ 20
As Shock A, except Electricity critical is an 'E'.
@@ 25
As Mind Shout I, except area of effect is 50' radius and any target failing by
more than 50 is unconscious for eight hours.
@@ 30
As Mind Shout I, except area of effect is 300' radius.
@@ 50
As Mind Shout (50' radius), except targets failing by 1-50 are unconscious,
and targets failing by more than 50 are dead. RRs for Mentalism spell users
are modified by -20.
